room_rent.note: Normal Single Private Room as per Schedule of Benefits

icu.note: ICU at actuals as per Schedule of Benefits

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay; optional voluntary co-pay of 10%, 20%, or 30% available

sub_limits.display: LASIK ₹50k, Cataract ₹1L/eye, Bariatric 50% SI max ₹5L, Road Ambulance ₹2k
sub_limits.note: LASIK up to ₹50,000; Cataract up to ₹1,00,000 per eye; Bariatric up to 50% of SI max ₹5L; Road ambulance ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24 months for most listed conditions (e.g. cataract, hernia, LASIK); 36 months for joint replacement and osteoarthritis/osteoporosis

maternity.note: Normal delivery up to ₹50,000; Caesarean up to ₹75,000; max 2 events lifetime; surrogate mother covered with conditions

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% per claim-free year; max 50% of base SI; reduces at same rate on claim

restoration.note: 100% of base SI restored once per policy year for second claim; available for same or new illness; triggered even if SI partially exhausted

domiciliary.note: Up to 20% of SI; cashless via empanelled provider; pre-authorisation required; not available under Essential plan per schedule (shows 'Not Available' for Home Health Care)

ayush.note: Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy; in-patient at AYUSH hospital only

ambulance.note: Road ambulance ₹2,000 per hospitalisation; Air ambulance not available under Essential plan

modern_treatments.note: Robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy etc. covered up to SI

consumables.note: Standard non-payable items list (Annexure III) excludes gloves, masks, etc.

global_cover.note: Treatment outside India excluded per Section 6.2.15

notable_exclusions: Treatment outside India, commercial/traditional surrogacy, stem cell storage (inbuilt exclusion waived for newborn benefit), external congenital anomaly, venereal disease (non-HIV)
optional_riders: Critical Illness lump sum (21 conditions), Personal Accident (AD/PTD/PPD), Voluntary Co-payment (10%/20%/30%)
